title: Fire Alarm Asset Record
description: Canonical metadata record for a collected source asset used to bootstrap, review, and curate fire alarm device datasets. Internet collection is bootstrap-only until the source and asset are explicitly approved. Unclear-license sources must not be treated as training-approved.

asset_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the asset record.

source_url.description: Original source URL or internal URI where the asset was obtained.

source_domain.description: Registered domain or internal source identifier for provenance tracking.

license_status.description: Conservative asset licensing status. Only explicitly approved assets should be used for training.

collected_at.description: UTC timestamp when the asset was collected into the ML workspace.

content_type.description: Detected MIME type such as image/jpeg, application/pdf, or text/html.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the raw asset bytes in lowercase hexadecimal.

phash.description: Optional perceptual hash for duplicate analysis.

ocr_text.description: Extracted OCR text or document text snippet associated with the asset.

weak_labels.description: Optional weak labels inferred from filenames, surrounding text, page content, or source metadata. These are not gold labels.

manufacturer.description: Weak manufacturer hint. Unknown is allowed until human review.

device_type.description: Weak coarse device type hint aligned to the public module contract.

subtype.description: Optional richer internal subtype hint such as smoke, heat, wall sounder, or sounder-beacon.

model_hint.description: Optional weak model family hint extracted from text.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the weak label set when available.

manufacturer.description: Reviewed or declared manufacturer for the asset as a whole when known.

device_types.description: Possible coarse device types depicted or described by the asset.

review_status.description: Workflow state for human review and downstream use approval.

approval_notes.description: Reviewer notes about licensing, provenance, label quality, or rejection reasons.

bootstrap_only.description: True when the asset was obtained through bootstrap internet collection and still requires explicit source approval before training use.

raw_path.description: Relative workspace path to the stored raw asset.

preview_path.description: Relative workspace path to a preview image or rendered thumbnail.

metadata.description: Optional ingestion metadata kept open for practical tool-specific extensions.
